Part 1 - Classes and Methods / ODWindowState

GetTotalRootWindowCount

The GetTotalRootWindowCount method returns the total number of root windows of all open drafts. 
ODUShort GetTotalRootWindowCount ();
return value
The number of root windows of all drafts, expressed as an unsigned 16-bit value.
SEE ALSO
The ODWindowState::GetRootWindowCount method (page 861).
